title: Rename a column that has a foreign key
sql: ALTER TABLE enrollment RENAME COLUMN std_id TO student_id
notes: No attribute assertions: upstream gives enrollment.std_id no attribute even at T0 (9 of 27 FK columns have one), so their absence after the rename says nothing.

gold_overrides.x04: SELECT count(*) FROM enrollment e JOIN std_mst s ON s.std_id = e.student_id WHERE s.rec_sts = 'active'
